title: fiig package manifest (fiig.pkg.json)
description: A fiig package: its path, kind, version, and what it depends on and provides (ADR 0032, ADR 0035, ADR 0043).

path.description: The package's canonical dotted path, e.g. acme.payments. Paths starting with fiig. are reserved for packages the toolchain ships.

formerly.description: The paths this package had before a rename, newest last. Migration history recorded under one of them is moved to path the next time the program migrates (ADR 0138).

kind.description: An application is a program that runs; a library is used by applications.

dependencies.description: Package path to the minimum version required (ADR 0032's minimal version selection).

capabilities.description: Every capability this application's code and dependencies may require (ADR 0035).

nativeCapabilities.description: Capabilities backed by the host rather than a fiig provider, such as Database (ADR 0042's grandfather list).

origin.description: Where the package comes from, recorded in the lockfile (ADR 0037).

provides.description: Interface (by package path and name, e.g. fiig.sql.SqlDriver) to the capability group in this package that fulfils it (ADR 0043).

environment.description: In an application: package path to renamed environment variables, old name to new (ADR 0071 §5).

concurrency.description: In an application: the bounds on a concurrent block (ADR 0149). default is the limit of a block with no limit: (16 when omitted); maximum is the most any one block runs at once, whatever its limit: says.
